description: Boeing 737-200 first delivered to Nordair (Canada) in November 1975 as; or later becoming; N103HA; subsequently operated by Air Florida; America West Airlines and Canadian Airlines. Exported to Nicaragua in 2009; made its last flight that year; and was re-registered TG-REX in November 2010. In August 2012 the Sandinista government installed it as a walk-through public exhibit in the new amusement/leisure complex on the Managua Malecón at Plaza La Fe; adjacent to Puerto Salvador Allende. AP photographed the public queueing to board it on 16 September 2012; it was still in place and marked "Poder Ciudadano" with the slogans "Alegría de Vivir en Paz" and "Solidaridad Cristiana Socialista" when photographed on 3 February 2024 and logged by oldjets.net in February 2024. Complete airframe; repainted; interior open to visitors. The Guatemalan registration TG-REX is the identity it carries; N103HA is the earlier US one — treat the TG- mark as current and verify against a recent photo before publishing.
